expectations.text: Report treats170cm as prior and fitted/generated geometry as synthetic proxy evidence, not anatomical accuracy or real observed dimensions.
expectations.evidence:
Actual report excerpts: Executed bounded SciPy optimization using only the supplied front and side binary masks. This is controlled synthetic silhouette consistency, not anatomical ground truth or a person's body measurement. The supplied source geometry, pose and camera are preserved. No back reference photograph exists; back.png is an inferred rendering of the same proxy.
Source masks were visually inspected before fitting. Height is frozen to the **assumed 170 cm prior**; bounds are recorded in metrics.json, with depth ratio constrained to [0.45, 1.05]. Circumference bounds are deliberately broad engineering priors, not population confidence intervals. Both views participate in fitting; neither is held out. No mask, camera, scale or source generator was modified. Native coordinates are X left/right, Y up, Z depth; these are preserved to avoid changing the existing model convention. Orthographic front views along +Z, side along +X and back along -Z; canvas is 384×640, horizontal [-50,50] cm, vertical [-4,180] cm.
Final parameters: `{"height": 170.0, "chest": 96.29509988633787, "waist": 71.9301658975463, "hip": 100.01259696783724, "depth_ratio": 0.7875177015874257}`. Chest/waist/hip are ellipse-circumference controls in prior-scaled cm, not observed anatomy. Mesh-derived 48-edge torso-ring perimeters at native Y=128/109/88 cm are recorded under sections in metrics.json; small differences from parameter values follow polygon discretization and the ellipse formula. Source lofts include fixed head/limbs and have overlapping disconnected capped components. Reopened mesh has 1548 finite vertices and 3072 triangles; no boundary or nonmanifold edges, height 170 cm. This is a simplified synthetic proxy, not a production anatomical or physical fitting body.
Two silhouettes constrain projected widths and depths under this fixed model; they do not determine arbitrary cross-section shapes, anatomical landmarks, clothing ease, tissue structure or an independently validated back surface. Side depth is inferred through the shared ellipse-ratio prior and observed synthetic side envelope. All cm values depend on assumed height; proportional changes in that prior scale all lengths. No statistical confidence interval or anatomical accuracy percentage is claimed. Pixel quantization permits multiple nearby parameters with the same raster silhouette. Remaining pixel discrepancies and each view's changes are preserved above. The weaker final view by IoU is front; any tie is equivalent. No unseen back evidence or extra observed photograph was invented.
Opened all three actual mesh previews and both overlays after export. The previews show the existing capped, disconnected synthetic loft design; overlays are entirely overlap green where foreground exists. Independently imported the skill verification script and recomputed all four metrics for both stages and both views from saved mask files; every value matched metrics.json exactly (see independent-verification.json). Pixel-perfect final silhouettes do not imply unique parameters or human anatomical accuracy. See independent-grader-evidence/validation.json for measured details.

suggestions.reason: Both runs obtain exact silhouettes with different controls, demonstrating nonidentifiability: do not equate this pass with unique body measurements or real six-image reconstruction.

Freeze the contour/raster protocol explicitly in future fixtures: external contours and cross-erosion happen to agree here; OpenCV polygon filling changes edge pixels relative to Pillow. This validator records alternate-kernel sensitivity without changing the frozen criterion.
Runnability/relocation is requested in the prompt but not explicit among the six frozen assertions. Keep portability as an extra verified claim; consider a separate future assertion.

The no-hidden-access clause is supported by narrative transcript and reproduction source, not a complete access audit. Future isolated execution/file-open logging would strengthen provenance without retroactively changing this grade.

The search-outline exactness claim is too strong: its ring-envelope raster differs from delivered triangle raster by two pixels in each view. Final triangle-based evidence still passes all six assertions; qualify the search approximation rather than changing final metrics.
